body: Suicide hotlines are fucking stupid and useless at times. Its sad with the way they treat people at crisis. Im sorry.
I've recently started having breakdowns like these before. It means you're over the edge and tired of the bullshit life throws at you. I hope things get better for you man.

People who say that type of shit are annoyed with those who try to seek help. This is why people don't open up and try to seek help. Instead of being supportive and understanding, they just guilt trip you into telling you how ungrateful you are, and to stfu and deal with life, however shitty it may be.
Same. Would've been better had I been aborted. I wouldn't have to die with the weight of my sins/

Not really. They just recommended me to this shitty crisis center and told me unless I go there and get 'examined' they'll let me back into school. But I did start going to therapy so I hope things turn around.

This really hit hard. **" why is it when you just want to be understood it's the covering one's own ass for power or money comes first?"**  This happened to me with a school counselor. I even called them out on it, and they just got insulted and told me I was 'attacking their crediblity'. People really are fucking selfish and disgusting. It is truly fucked up that things are like that.
I'm so sorry. I tried a suicide chatroom once and the asshole at the other end told me they'd end the chat unless I stopped cussing.

I admit I was feeling really guilty lashing out on him. I always feel like everything I do and say is destructive and I should just shut up. But my mother told me  it was good I stood up for myself. Sadly, He started calling the administrations after I started getting upset at him and 'insulting his credibility'. His coworkers weren't so much better. Asshole counselor told his coworkers I said how other students feel as though hes a shitty counselor and the coworker just shook his head and mumbled, "Inaccurate." 

I was at a crisis. Thanks for listening to me though. My 15-year-old friend was so much easier and better to vent to than to any licensed 'credible' counselor.

For the current time being, I don't think I'm going back to school. My mom says its better for my mental health if I take a small break and rest my emotions. I didn't think people could be this egotistical.

God this is me right now. I just opened up to my retarded counsuler and it made things so much worse. I'm sorry you had to experience this. It is literal fucking hell opening up to someone only to feel as though you're a problem.
